static ALPHA: &str = "alpha";
static BETA: &str = "βeta";
static TABLE: std::sync::LazyLock<std::sync::RwLock<StringTable>> =
    std::sync::LazyLock::new(init_table);
fn init_table() -> std::sync::RwLock<StringTable> {
    std::sync::RwLock::new(StringTable::new())
}
static PUBLISHES: std::sync::Mutex<usize> = std::sync::Mutex::new(0);
fn main() {
    let table = TABLE.write().unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner);
    for index in [0, 1023, 1024, 3071, 3072, 4000] {
        table.publish(index, &ALPHA);
        *PUBLISHES.lock().unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner) += 1;
        assert_eq!(table.get(index), "alpha");
    }
    table.publish(1024, &BETA);
    assert_eq!(table.get(1024), "βeta");
    assert_eq!(table.get(0), "alpha");
    drop(table);
    assert_eq!(*PUBLISHES.lock().unwrap(), 6);
    let table = TABLE.read().unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner);
    for index in [0, 1023, 1024, 3071, 3072, 4000] {
        println!("{} {}", index, table.get(index));
    }
}
